scope: Privacy class on a property contract, and any payload that claims to have applied it.
does: Reject a public or masked property whose name looks like an email, phone, or similar personal fact.
Reject a payload that still carries an excluded property name.
doesNot: Treat excluded as a value that may be copied.
Put a personal value in the example contract.

claims.text: A public property named like an email fails, and a payload that includes an excluded name fails.
The meridian example's workEmail is excluded, so the name itself is not a public-name finding.
